title: Lookup in a mapped list
statement: Let $f$ map elements of a type $\alpha$ to elements of a type $\beta$, and let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$. For any position $i<|l|$ and defaults $d\in\alpha$ and $d'\in\beta$, the lookup at position $i$ in the list obtained by applying $f$ to every entry of $l$, with default $d'$, equals $f$ applied to the lookup at position $i$ in $l$ with default $d$.
